notes: Dates and fees are from 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
name: MIPA Summer Journalism Workshop (MSU)
org: Michigan Interscholastic Press Association (MIPA), Michigan State University
what_you_do: Spend five days on the MSU campus with expert teachers. You build news skills like writing, photos, design, yearbook and news anchoring.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 7 to 12 in the fall.
pay_detail: 2026 fee: $560 for MIPA member schools, $610 for others, plus $75 after June 15. Covers housing, meals and classes. Scholarships and fundraising help are available.
duration: 5 days, in person at MSU. 2026 dates: July 19 to 23.
deadline_text: 2026 workshop was July 19 to 23, 2026. Registration ran to July 1, 2026 or until seats filled. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the registration link on the MIPA page. Phone 517-353-6761, email ask@mipamsu.org.
